reason: V1 GroupPermissions.canView(group) (GroupPermissions.java:254-257) calls canView()/canManage() first. V2 GroupPermissionsV2.canView(group) calls hasPermission(group.getId(), VIEW, MANAGE), and when the group has no resource of its own, hasPermission falls back to the 'Groups' resource-type resource and evaluates the all-groups permissions (GroupPermissionsV2.java hasPermission, patch lines ~668-679), so admins with only global Groups VIEW/MANAGE still see the groups and listings are not empty.
